title: Elf Bar Elfx Mega Replacement Vape Pods 2ml
description: These replacement pods are designed exclusively for the Elf Bar ELFX Mega Pod Kit. They feature Elf Bar’s advanced QUAQ DURA technology, a dual-mesh coil design that reinforces the coil structure to deliver up to three times the lifespan of standard single-mesh pods. Each pod holds 2ml of e-liquid and features a clean, leak-resistant side-fill port. The built-in coils mean there is no messy maintenance—simply replace the whole pod when the flavour fades. The 0.6ohm pod is best for "Turbo Mode" and a looser, airy draw (RDL), while the 0.8ohm pod is ideal for "ECO Mode" and a tighter, cigarette-style draw (MTL). Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
